appUrls.title: App Store or Google Play URLs
appUrls.description: Paste iOS App Store or Google Play Store URLs. The actor auto-detects the platform. Example: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/instagram/id389801252  or  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.instagram.android

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Maximum reviews per app
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Hard cap per app. iOS RSS feed returns at most 500 per country. Android via scraper returns up to a few thousand.

iosCountries.title: iOS country storefronts
iosCountries.description: iOS reviews differ per country storefront. Leave empty to use 'us'. Example: us, gb, de, fr, jp.

androidCountry.title: Android country
androidCountry.description: Two-letter country code for Google Play reviews.

androidLanguage.title: Android language
androidLanguage.description: Language code for Google Play reviews.

sortBy.title: Sort reviews by
sortBy.description: Sort order for Google Play reviews. iOS RSS is always most recent.

filterByRating.title: Filter by rating
filterByRating.description: Only return reviews with these star ratings. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Leave empty for all.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Datacenter proxies are enough for both iOS RSS and Play Store.
